cachedReport.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 297ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is application-side, specifically: Cosmos DB 429 RateLimitExceeded: 25 in last 5 min on products container; Hot partition pattern active: all writes routing to fixed partition key 'hot-category'; Multiple CosmosClient instances: new client created per request instead of singleton. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 12ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
cachedReport.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 297ms with 25 Cosmos 429 events, 890 RU/min consumption, host CPU 75%, and SQL latency 0.12ms. The active toggles (hotPartition, multipleClients, highCpu) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 285ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
